about: Charleville Forest candidates from Heritage Trees of Ireland (Tree Council of Ireland / Aubrey Fennell, 2009 survey, coordinates converted from Irish Grid, about 100 m, ages are 2009 bands). Not delivered because the register carries no names, no vitality, and no tree can be told apart on the ground. Delivered in data/research/tullamore-verified.json: tlm_002 (yew).

leads.source: Heritage Trees of Ireland, Tree Council of Ireland / Aubrey Fennell (NBDC dataset 27, CC BY 4.0), survey 2009
leads.reason: Spindle is a small shrubby tree; 300-500 year band is implausible and the 'significant habitat' note says nothing a visitor can see; no second source

leads.name: Giant oak alone in pasture near Charleville Lake
leads.source: https://www.irishtimes.com/news/a-verdant-preserve-in-peril-1.277090 (3 Feb 2001, 'recognised as the largest oak in Ireland', between lake and the Tullamore-Birr road, no size given)
leads.reason: No coordinate, no size, 2001 article only; may be on private farmland; may well be a different tree from any register record

leads.name: Island oaks, Charleville Lake
leads.source: https://www.irishtimes.com/news/a-verdant-preserve-in-peril-1.277090 (about 8 acres of ancient woodland on a lake island, some oaks 18th century per 1971 survey)
leads.reason: Island, no public access established; woodland, not a collectible point
